NORAD ID: 42900
Int'l Code: 2017-044A
Launch date: August 2, 2017
Source: Italy (IT)
Launch site: FRENCH GUIANA (FRGUI)

OPTSAT 3000 is an optical surveillance craft for the Italian military. Dropped off in a Sun-synchronous orbit, OPTSAT 3000 was built by Israel Aerospace Industries (IAI) based on inter-governmental Italian-Israeli agreements. It will enable national defense entities to acquire and use high-resolution images from any part of the globe.
